functionalReqs: Update recommendations within seconds of user actions
Session-aware ranking (current intent beats long-term history)
hints: Batch-computed features are hours old. How do you get features that are seconds old?
Training/serving skew is the classic bug here. How does a feature store help?

Clickstream → Kafka → stream processor computes session features (recent categories, last items, dwell) → online feature store (Redis) and offline store (logged for training, point-in-time correct); session model (sequence model or GRU/transformer over recent events) plus long-term embeddings; contextual bandit for exploration; A/B test conversion and latency.
nonFunctionalReqs: Events reflected in features within ~5 s
Consistent features between training and serving
problemStatement: Design **real-time personalisation** for an e-commerce or food app: the home page and recommendations react within seconds to what the user is doing in the current session (searches, clicks, cart).

scaleHints.storage: Feature store with online and offline views

title: Design Real-time Personalization
